610001.label: Q1
610001.prompt_html: Buckeye Furniture makes tables and chairs. A table needs 4 hours of carpentry and 2 hours of finishing; a chair needs 3 hours of carpentry and 1 hour of finishing. Each week 240 carpentry hours and 100 finishing hours are available. Each table earns $70 profit and each chair $50. Formulate an LP that maximizes weekly profit.

610001.label: Q1a
610001.answer_key: x₁ = tables built per week, x₂ = chairs built per week

610001.label: Q2a
610001.prompt_html: List every corner point of the feasible region.

610001.label: Q2b
610001.prompt_html: Give the optimal solution and its profit.

610001.label: Q3
610001.prompt_html: Suppose the finishing constraint is removed. Is the LP still bounded? Give the new optimum.
610001.answer_key: Still bounded: carpentry limits both products. New optimum x₁ = 60, x₂ = 0, z = $4,200.

610003.label: Q1
610003.prompt_html: Convert to standard form: min z = 2x₁ − 3x₂ subject to x₁ + x₂ ≤ 8, 2x₁ − x₂ ≥ 2, x₁ ≥ 0, x₂ free.

610003.label: Q1a
610003.answer_key: x₁ + x₂ + s₁ = 8; 2x₁ − x₂ − s₂ = 2; s₁, s₂ ≥ 0

610003.label: Q1b
610003.prompt_html: Handle the free variable and write the objective in max form.
610003.answer_key: x₂ = x₂⁺ − x₂⁻ with x₂⁺, x₂⁻ ≥ 0; max −z = −2x₁ + 3x₂⁺ − 3x₂⁻

610003.label: Q2
610003.prompt_html: Solve with the simplex method: max z = 5x₁ + 4x₂ subject to 6x₁ + 4x₂ ≤ 24, x₁ + 2x₂ ≤ 6, x₁, x₂ ≥ 0.

610003.label: Q2a
610003.prompt_html: Set up the initial tableau and choose the entering and leaving variables.
610003.answer_key: Entering x₁ (most negative z-row coefficient, −5); ratios 24/6 = 4 and 6/1 = 6, so s₁ leaves.

610003.label: Q2b
610003.prompt_html: Perform pivots until the tableau is optimal. Show each tableau.
610003.answer_key: Pivot 1 on row s₁; pivot 2: x₂ enters, s₂ leaves (ratio 2 / (4/3) = 1.5). Final: x₁ = 3, x₂ = 1.5.

610003.label: Q2c
610003.prompt_html: State the optimal solution, the optimal value and which constraints are binding.
610003.answer_key: x₁ = 3, x₂ = 1.5, z = 21; both constraints binding (s₁ = s₂ = 0).

610003.label: Q3
610003.prompt_html: A refinery blends light (L) and heavy (H) crude into 1,000 barrels of fuel. At least 40% must be light crude, light costs $60/bbl and heavy $45/bbl, and at most 700 bbl of light crude is available. Formulate a minimum-cost LP.

610005.label: Q1
610005.prompt_html: Scarlet Bakery bakes bagels and muffins. A dozen bagels uses 2 kg of flour and 1 hour of oven time; a dozen muffins uses 1 kg of flour and 1 hour of oven time. Each day 40 kg of flour and 30 oven hours are available, and at least 5 dozen muffins must be baked. Profit is $9 per dozen bagels and $7 per dozen muffins. Formulate an LP that maximizes daily profit.

610005.label: Q1a
610005.answer_key: x₁ = dozens of bagels per day, x₂ = dozens of muffins per day

610005.label: Q1c
610005.answer_key: 2x₁ + x₂ ≤ 40; x₁ + x₂ ≤ 30; x₂ ≥ 5; x₁, x₂ ≥ 0

610005.label: Q2
610005.prompt_html: Convert to standard form: max z = x₁ + 4x₂ subject to −x₁ + x₂ ≤ 3, 3x₁ + x₂ ≥ 6, x₁ ≥ 0, x₂ free.

610005.label: Q2a
610005.prompt_html: Write the constraints as equalities with slack/surplus variables.
610005.answer_key: −x₁ + x₂ + s₁ = 3; 3x₁ + x₂ − s₂ = 6; s₁, s₂ ≥ 0

610005.label: Q2b
610005.prompt_html: Handle the free variable x₂ and rewrite the objective.
610005.answer_key: x₂ = x₂⁺ − x₂⁻, x₂⁺, x₂⁻ ≥ 0; max z = x₁ + 4x₂⁺ − 4x₂⁻

610005.label: Q3
610005.prompt_html: Simplex: max z = 2x₁ + 3x₂ subject to x₁ + 2x₂ ≤ 8, 3x₁ + 2x₂ ≤ 12, x₁, x₂ ≥ 0.

610005.label: Q3a
610005.prompt_html: Choose the entering and leaving variables for the first pivot.
610005.answer_key: x₂ enters (−3); ratios 8/2 = 4, 12/2 = 6, so s₁ leaves.

610005.label: Q3b
610005.answer_key: Pivot 2: x₁ enters, s₂ leaves. Optimal x₁ = 2, x₂ = 3.

610005.label: Q3c
610005.prompt_html: State the optimal solution and value; explain how you know it is optimal.
610005.answer_key: x₁ = 2, x₂ = 3, z = 13; optimal because all z-row coefficients are ≥ 0.

610005.label: Q4
610005.prompt_html: Graphical method: max z = 5x₁ + 5x₂ subject to x₁ + x₂ ≤ 8, x₁ ≤ 5, x₂ ≤ 6, x₁, x₂ ≥ 0.

610005.label: Q4a
610005.prompt_html: List the corner points of the feasible region.

610005.label: Q4b
610005.answer_key: Every point on the segment between (2, 6) and (5, 3) is optimal with z = 40: the objective is parallel to x₁ + x₂ ≤ 8.
